text:
ana: thinking about adding an "alert + mini-sparkline" for model cost spikes on the per-model econ card. tiny 30m history, 15m predicted, stacked token-cost + cache-savings. lightweight UX.
bryan: +1. do we want hard thresholds or anomaly-score? thresholds are simple but noisy across tenants.
lucy: anomaly-score is better. we can compute z-score over rolling baseline (3h) and flag >3sigma. show score in tooltip.
dante: implementation note: full-precision per-invocation costs are heavy. can we reuse existing sampled ingest (0.5%)? preserve sample_weight and compute weighted z.
bryan: if sampled, add a badge "estimate" and show sample_rate. also show raw_count so tiny N is visible.
nana: (typo) ana: yes, show sample metadata. also prefer sending an "alert_reason" field so consumers can render human text.
lucy: API sketch: 
```
GET /api/console/v1/models/{model}/spike?window=30m&forecast=15m
resp: timestamps[], token_cost[], cache_savings[], anomaly_score[], is_estimated="true", sample_rate="0.005", sample_n="42", alert_reason="high_anomaly"
```
dante: we need to resolve attribution for chained calls: token emission by downstream model should not be charged twice if it's fed into another model within same request. I'd attribute generated tokens to the producing model and route-reads to the consuming route. document that.
elder: cache_hit taxonomy: router_prefetch vs local_sidecar_kv vs remote_shared_cache. current tags are inconsistent — I'll open a normalization PR.
nana: infra-bot: Job queued: telemetry/preserve-sample-weight and cache-tag-normalize @ 2024-09-12T04:00Z
bryan: rollout plan: behind flag, alpha tenants + infra team for 2 weeks, then canary. GA only when backfilled baseline looks stable.
lucy: about backfill: recomputing full-precision 7d is costly. alternate: extrapolate from sampled series to generate historical sparklines and anomaly baselines. cheaper and consistent with the realtime logic.
dante: agree. we should also store per-minute sample_n so backfilled confidence bands are meaningful.
elder: I'll audit existing pipelines for missing sample_n fields. might need a small schema bump.
nana: small UX ask: when anomaly is estimated show a hover text: "estimated via 0.5% sampled traces; confidence band computed from weighted variance". keep it short.
bryan: test cases: synthetic spike, cold-cache warmup, and prefetch double-counting. please add to the e2e checklist.
lucy: i'll mock widget with three toggles: sample_rate, anomaly_threshold, show_estimates. will need a fake API for dev.
dante: i'll implement endpoint + flag. tagging @lucy @elder for reviews.
elder: PR incoming for cache tags normalization.
nana: thanks team. i'll open a ticket with the mock CSV and link the rollout doc. :raised_hands:
